_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N359145 (2026-03-02, held-out Part 102 window final; subject: "The tariff classification, United States-Mexico-Canada Trade Agreement (USMCA), and country of origin of wooden furniture."). Frozen by the D570 rule before any run. CBP held Canada. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 held-out suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (9403.60.8040). Family and name: the family check (furniture, 1); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (3: eco-poxy resin, dyes, pigments). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Canada. Target Thailand by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for Thailand are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D570.
